notes.title: Update notes for late-November 2021
notes.notes: Now, while waiting for a game to start, there is a fun way to transform your character.  Can you discover it?  Watch for a puff of smoke when it happens!

notes.title: Update notes for mid-November 2021
notes.notes: Fixed movement for players on some systems.

notes.title: Update notes for November 2021
notes.notes: Now, you can always play!  If you don't have anybody to join you in a session, we'll still get a game going, and you'll get to play as the baddie.

notes.title: Update notes for October 2021
notes.notes: In this update we make it occasionally windy, add some links to social media, add a clearer join button, and analyze what's going on a tiny bit.  Please enjoy!
